name: Anime Scope – Unexpected Stories from Real-Life Professionals
original_name: あにめすこ～ぷ ～アニメを本職に見せたら聞いた事ない話が飛び出した件～
overview: “Anime Scope is an AT-X original talk program where real-life professionals are invited to watch anime related to their field of expertise. The hosts explore unique insights, behind-the-scenes knowledge, and surprising perspectives that only professionals can offer, resulting in conversations that viewers normally would never hear.”
